englishTitle: Spanish Royal Couple Visits Ceuta After Migration Crisis
englishSummary: King Felipe of Spain and Queen Letizia visited the Spanish exclave of Ceuta on Tuesday, two and a half months after thousands of migrants illegally crossed the border from Morocco. The visit came after significant anger among Ceuta residents, who felt abandoned during the crisis in May when Moroccan authorities allowed an estimated 10,000 people to enter the territory. Spanish border officials were overwhelmed as migrants swam around border fences or walked across the beach. The royal couple met with local authorities and residents to show solidarity with the enclave. "This visit was badly needed," said Ceuta's mayor Juan Vivas, thanking the king for his presence during the difficult period.

englishTitle: OpenAI Discovers Hidden Recording Device in Office, Employee Arrested

The discovery was confirmed by the U.S. Department of Justice. An employee has been arrested in connection with the device, which was allegedly planted in an executive meeting room. The sophisticated equipment was reportedly capable of recording audio and transmitting it externally. The company said it is cooperating fully with federal authorities investigating the incident. OpenAI declined to provide further details about the employee or potential motives, citing the ongoing investigation.

The Eindhoven side dominated possession and created several scoring opportunities, but failed to convert them. A missed penalty by Ivan Perišić in the first half proved costly, as Leipzig scored the only goal in the 76th minute. PSV now has one point from three Champions League matches and faces an uphill battle to qualify for the knockout stages.

At the end of the evening, Jakob Söderqvist and Lieke Nooijen claimed the first orange leader's jerseys. The innovative format received positive reactions from riders and spectators, with many praising the equal visibility given to both competitions. Trump announced earlier this week that he had asked for her resignation, stating that "the allegations are serious and warrant her immediate departure." englishTitle: Former Gang Member Sentenced to 40 Years for Tupac Shakur Murder
englishSummary: Duane "Keffe D" Davis, 63, has been sentenced to at least 40 years in prison for the 1996 murder of hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur, a judge in Las Vegas ruled Tuesday. Davis was convicted in August by a jury of premeditated murder with use of a deadly weapon. He is the only person ever charged in connection with Shakur's death, which occurred in a drive-by shooting on the Las Vegas Strip nearly 30 years ago. Prosecutors presented evidence that Davis orchestrated the shooting and handed the gun to his nephew, who fired the fatal shots. Davis had previously boasted about his involvement in interviews and a memoir. The case remained unsolved for decades until Davis's own admissions led to his arrest in 2025.

"Russia is our adversary in this conflict, and we should not be doing business with them while they continue their aggression." The Dutch cabinet has called on the U.S. to reconsider the deal, which critics say undermines Western sanctions against Moscow. The agreement has also drawn criticism from other European allies.

Doctors said they caught the cancer in its early stages and are optimistic about the pope's prognosis. These represent the largest series of attacks since the beginning of U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran in late February. The strategic waterway, through which about one-fifth of the world's oil passes, has seen several incidents involving Iranian naval forces stopping and boarding commercial vessels. Western intelligence sources told the FT that Iran appears to be responding to recent diplomatic pressure and economic sanctions. The U.S. Navy's Fifth Fleet, which patrols the region, said it is monitoring the situation closely and coordinating with international partners to ensure freedom of navigation through the vital shipping lane.

Meynard died in 2012 under circumstances that initially required an autopsy, but the body was never claimed by family and the case was apparently forgotten by authorities. The discovery was made during a routine inventory of the facility in Lyon. French authorities have opened an investigation into how such an administrative failure could occur and continue for over a decade.

The approved measures give the IND more time to process applications and adjust the penalty structure. Opposition parties criticized the decision, arguing it removes an important incentive for timely processing.
